headlines.description: — If this playoff run is about redemption for the Boston Celtics, it had to start with exacting some revenge against the Miami Heat.
headlines.shortLinkText: Celtics advance to East semifinals, beating short-handed Heat 118-84 in Game 5

headlines.description: — Luka Doncic is playing on a sprained right knee that would probably sideline him in the regular season. The Dallas star also has been congested and ill for several days, fighting a bug that's forcing him to blow his nose during timeouts.
headlines.shortLinkText: Luka Doncic scores 35 points, leads Mavericks to 123-93 victory and 3-2 series lead over Clippers

headlines.description: — T.J. McConnell and Obi Toppin complemented one another's play perfectly Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pacers celebrate 1st playoff series victory in a decade, beating Bucks 120-98 in Game 6

headlines.description: — With a frenzied Philly crowd clamoring for defense, Josh Hart hesitated for just a second after Jalen Brunson passed him the ball from the left wing before Hart realized the 76ers weren't playing any D on him.
headlines.shortLinkText: Knicks advance to the Eastern Conference semis, topping 76ers 118-115 in Game 6

headlines.description: — Paolo Banchero and the rapidly maturing Orlando Magic are growing up fast in the NBA playoffs.
headlines.shortLinkText: Paolo Banchero scores 27 points, Magic overcome Mitchell's 50 to beat Cavs 103-96 and force Game 7

headlines.description: — Luka Doncic struggled with his shot again thanks to his ailing right knee, and Kyrie Irving spent a bunch of energy playing defense.
headlines.shortLinkText: Luka Doncic and Kyrie Irving carry Mavs past Clippers 114-101 to advance to second round

headlines.description: — Anthony Edwards' decision-making was as spot-on as his shot-making.
headlines.shortLinkText: Edwards scores 43 points, Reid erupts in 4th to help Timberwolves beat Nuggets 106-99 in Game 1

headlines.description: — Donovan Mitchell brought redemption and relief to himself and the Cavaliers.
headlines.shortLinkText: Donovan Mitchell scores 39 points as Cavaliers push past Magic 106-94 in Game 7 to get Boston next

events.name: Indiana Pacers at New York Knicks

headlines.description: — Jalen Brunson doesn't go into a game aiming to score 40 points more consistently than anyone in the postseason since Michael Jordan.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brunson scores 43, rallies Knicks to 121-117 win over Pacers in Game 1 of Eastern Conference semis

headlines.description: — The Minnesota Timberwolves, led by Anthony Edwards and Karl-Anthony Towns, overpowered the Denver Nuggets on Monday night in a stunningly efficient 106-80 thrashing of the reigning but reeling NBA champions.
headlines.shortLinkText: Edwards, Towns lead Wolves' 106-80 blitz of Murray, Jokic for 2-0 series lead over champion Nuggets

headlines.description: — When Jaylen Brown or Jayson Tatum have it going, it usually means good things for the Boston Celtics.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brown, White lead Celtics' 3-point onslaught, powering Boston to 120-95 Game 1 win over Cavaliers

events.name: Dallas Mavericks at Oklahoma City Thunder

headlines.description: — Shai Gilgeous-Alexander was his usual self and Luka Doncic wasn't.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gilgeous-Alexander has 29 points to help Thunder roll past Mavericks in Game 1 of West semifinals

events.name: Indiana Pacers at New York Knicks

headlines.description: — Jalen Brunson left the locker room on an injured leg, walked onto the court and sent the Madison Square Garden crowd into a frenzy, just as Willis Reed had exactly 54 years earlier.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jalen Brunson returns from foot injury, sparks Knicks past Pacers for 2-0 lead in East semifinals

headlines.description: — Donovan Mitchell banked in a 3-pointer from a few steps beyond the top of the arc and could only shrug as he backpedaled back on defense. He followed with two baskets in the lane to give the Cleveland Cavaliers a 16-point lead.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mitchell's 29 points help Cavaliers blow out Celtics 118-94, tie series at 1 game apiece

events.name: Dallas Mavericks at Oklahoma City Thunder

headlines.description: — Luka Doncic limped around the court, often grimacing as he played through a sprained right knee and a bloodied left knee.
headlines.shortLinkText: Doncic scores 29 points as Mavericks top Thunder 119-110 to tie series at 1-1

events.name: New York Knicks at Indiana Pacers

headlines.description: — Tyrese Haliburton limped slowly to the microphone Friday night with a bad ankle, a sore tailbone and a battered body.
headlines.shortLinkText: Andrew Nembhard's late 3 gives Pacers 111-106 victory over Knicks. Indiana moves within 2-1

headlines.description: — The Denver Nuggets were simply too determined, too experienced, too proud and too talented to let their flop in the first two games define this series against the surging Minnesota Timberwolves.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nuggets bounce back with 117-90 blowout of Timberwolves behind 24 points from energized Murray

events.name: Oklahoma City Thunder at Dallas Mavericks

headlines.description: — Luka Doncic already had a balky right knee and an achy left ankle when he fell hard on his back while battling his primary defender, Lu Dort, for a loose ball.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kyrie Irving and Luka Doncic help Mavs hold off Thunder again for 2-1 lead in West semis

headlines.description: — Green uniforms. Big shots. Championship-level intensity.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jayson Tatum scores 33 points, Celtics rebound from loss to beat Cavs 106-93 for 2-1 series lead

events.name: New York Knicks at Indiana Pacers

headlines.description: — The Denver Nuggets were far from done after dropping the first two games of the Western Conference semifinals at home in humbling fashion.
headlines.shortLinkText: Defending champ Nuggets tie Timberwolves with 2nd straight road win, 115-107 in Game 4

headlines.description: — Even when it's supposed to be somewhat easy, the Boston Celtics have a weird way of making things hard.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jayson Tatum's 33 points help Celtics down short-handed Cavaliers 109-102 to take 3-1 lead in semis

events.name: Oklahoma City Thunder at Dallas Mavericks

headlines.description: — Shai Gilgeous-Alexander was making his normal share of shots through three quarters for Oklahoma City. Most of his teammates weren't, until it mattered most.
headlines.shortLinkText: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scores 34, Thunder overcome Mavs defense to even series 2-2

events.name: Indiana Pacers at New York Knicks

headlines.description: — The New York Knicks have one more step to climb to reach the Eastern Conference finals for the first time since 2000.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brunson scores 44, Knicks beat Pacers 121-91 to move a win away from conference finals

headlines.description: — Nikola Jokic received the Michael Jordan award from Commissioner Adam Silver before tipoff, then delivered a memorable playoff performance to celebrate his third MVP trophy Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jokic scores 40, Nuggets shut down Edwards in 112-97 win over Wolves for a 3-2 series lead

headlines.description: — Al Horford wanted to savor the moment.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jayson Tatum scores 25 to lead Celtics past Cavaliers 113-98 and into 3rd consecutive East finals

events.name: Dallas Mavericks at Oklahoma City Thunder

headlines.description: — Luka Doncic stopped worrying about calls and just played.
headlines.shortLinkText: Doncic posts 31-point triple-double as Mavericks top Thunder to take 3-2 series lead

headlines.description: — Anthony Edwards flashed seven fingers to the roaring crowd as he walked off for a fourth-quarter timeout during a blowout by the <a...
headlines.shortLinkText: Timberwolves force Game 7 by blowing out Nuggets 115-70 behind 27 points from Anthony Edwards

events.name: New York Knicks at Indiana Pacers

headlines.description: — Indiana Pacers coach Rick Carlisle challenged his team to play more physically and more tenaciously Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Siakam helps Pacers beat Knicks 116-103 in Game 6 to send Eastern Conference semifinals to the limit

events.name: Oklahoma City Thunder at Dallas Mavericks

headlines.description: — Kyrie Irving probably wondered if his uncanny run of closeout victories without a loss in his career was finally near an end.
headlines.shortLinkText: P.J. Washington's free throws finish rally as Mavericks beat Thunder 117-116 to reach West finals

events.name: Indiana Pacers at New York Knicks

headlines.description: — When the Indiana Pacers compiled one of the best offensive seasons in NBA history, they were just getting warmed up.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pacers set NBA playoff shooting mark, top Knicks 130-109 in Game 7 to make Eastern Conference finals

headlines.description: — Anthony Edwards overcame a slow start and the Timberwolves roared back from a 20-point second-half deficit to eliminate the reigning NBA champion Denver Nuggets 98-90 in a Game 7 Minnesota masterpiece on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Edwards leads Wolves back from 20-point deficit for 98-90 win over defending NBA champion Nuggets

headlines.description: — The Celtics entered the playoffs expecting to get everyone’s best shot.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tatum scores 36, Brown hits 3 to force OT and Celtics edge Pacers 133-128 in Game 1 of East finals

headlines.description: — Luka Doncic led a strong finish for the Dallas Mavericks, swishing crucial shots down the stretch, drawing a couple of fouls and even playing strong defense.
headlines.shortLinkText: Doncic leads strong close by Mavericks for 108-105 win over Wolves in Game 1 of West finals

headlines.description: — Jaylen Brown was a big enough problem for the Indiana Pacers even before an All-NBA snub that may have given him an added desire to show how much he can do for the Boston Celtics.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brown matches career playoff high with 40 points, Celtics beat Pacers to take 2-0 lead in East

headlines.description: — Luka Doncic searched to find space as the clock ticked down, using a screen to draw Defensive Player of the Year Rudy Gobert out to the top of the key and a crossover dribble to set up his step-back 3-pointer.
headlines.shortLinkText: Doncic lifts Mavericks with go-ahead 3 with 3 seconds left to top Wolves 109-108 for 2-0 lead

headlines.description: — Luka Doncic lunged for the ball after a steal by Anthony Edwards, knocking it far enough away to create a scramble and a jump ball the Dallas superstar won.
headlines.shortLinkText: Luka Doncic and Kyrie Irving each score 33 points as Mavs beat Wolves for 3-0 lead in West finals

headlines.description: — Derrick White stood stoically at midcourt as his teammates celebrated Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Celtics rally late again to close out Pacers for 4-0 sweep in Eastern Conference finals

headlines.description: — Karl-Anthony Towns finally found his rhythm, and the Timberwolves finally closed a game in the Western Conference finals.
headlines.shortLinkText: Towns, Edwards lift Wolves over Mavs 105-100 to avoid sweep in West finals

headlines.description: — Luka Doncic was in his element, hitting shots from everywhere on the court, hushing the crowd and flashing those sly smiles as the Dallas Mavericks delivered a knockout performance.
headlines.shortLinkText: Doncic's 36 points spur Mavericks to NBA Finals with 124-103 toppling of Timberwolves in Game 5
